ask: Your image's description goes to a stranger's machine, which also sees the image it creates, without knowing who you are. Create your images through the public network?
ask_note: Neither this machine nor your machines can create it right now. Your choice applies from now on; you can change it in Settings, This machine, Sharing computing power.
saved_yes: Noted: when your machines can't create an image, the public network creates it.
saved_no: Noted: your images don't go to strangers. You can change your choice in Settings, This machine, Sharing computing power.
closed_off: No image model can compute right now, here or on your online machines. A machine on the public network could create it if your creations could go to strangers (“Have my conversations computed by strangers”, in Settings, This machine, Sharing computing power); or install a model in “Images and videos”.
closed_mine_only: No image model can compute right now, here or on your online machines. A machine on the public network could create it, but this conversation stays on your machines (“On my machines only”, in Permissions under the message box).
closed_attachments: No image model can compute right now, here or on your online machines. A machine on the public network could create it, but an attached image never goes to a stranger: ask for it without an attached image.
closed_refused: No image model can compute right now, here or on your online machines. A machine on the public network could create it, with your consent (“Create my images through the public network”, in Settings, This machine, Sharing computing power); or install a model in “Images and videos”.
nobody: No image model can compute right now, here, on your online machines, or on the public network: install one in “Images and videos”, or try again in a moment.
too_big: This format is too large for a machine on the public network (one million pixels at most, 1,024 × 1,024): choose a smaller one.
machine: Created by a machine on the public network
computing: Being created by a machine on the public network
withdrawn: your images no longer go through the public network (Settings, or “On my machines only”)
nobody_now: no machine on the public network can create this image right now
failed: no machine on the public network could create it ({error})
